tools.name: Dell ProSupport ToolBox
tools.description: Central launcher interface for Dell ProSupport utilities and troubleshooting tools.
tools.whatItDoes: Provides one interface for launching all available Dell ProSupport utilities including log collectors, diagnostic tools, and maintenance scripts for Dell PowerEdge, Windows Server, Hyper-V, and Azure Local environments.
tools.valueProposition: Simplifies tool access and discovery, reduces time to find the right tool for specific troubleshooting scenarios, and provides a unified entry point for all Dell ProSupport utilities.

tools.name: AzHCIUrlChecker
tools.description: Connectivity checker for Azure Local endpoints and firewall requirements.
tools.whatItDoes: Checks connectivity to endpoints required by Azure Local as noted in Microsoft Azure Local documentation firewall requirements. Validates outbound connectivity for Azure Local deployments.
tools.valueProposition: Quickly identifies firewall, proxy, and outbound connectivity issues that can block Azure Local functionality, reducing troubleshooting time for network-related deployment failures.

tools.name: BOILER
tools.description: CBS and DISM log analyzer for Windows servicing failures and corruption.
tools.whatItDoes: Analyzes CBS and DISM logs for errors, failures, warnings, failed KBs, language-pack issues, and corruption. Provides suggested remediation when recognized scenarios are detected.
tools.valueProposition: Dramatically reduces Windows Update and component-store troubleshooting time by automatically identifying root causes and providing specific remediation guidance for common servicing issues.

tools.name: DART
tools.description: Dell Automated Server Updater for Windows Failover Cluster and HCI/S2D environments.
tools.whatItDoes: Windows Failover Cluster and HCI/S2D-aware utility that can install Windows Updates and Dell driver/firmware updates. Includes cluster node maintenance workflows and automated reboot management.
tools.valueProposition: Automates complex update processes for clustered environments, reduces manual intervention and human error, and ensures consistent update application across Dell server infrastructure.

tools.name: FLEP
tools.description: Windows event log filter for common server, failover-clustering, and storage events.
tools.whatItDoes: Filters Windows event logs for common server, failover-clustering, storage, and Storport events. Quickly narrows large event logs to commonly relevant events for troubleshooting.
tools.valueProposition: Reduces time spent analyzing large event logs by filtering to relevant events, helps identify patterns and issues faster, and focuses troubleshooting efforts on actionable event data.

tools.name: GetHyperVBottlenecks
tools.whatItDoes: Detects potential performance bottlenecks in Hyper-V environments by analyzing system metrics and configuration. Provides interactive prompts to guide performance analysis.
tools.valueProposition: Identifies Hyper-V performance issues before they impact production, provides actionable insights for optimization, and reduces time spent on performance troubleshooting.

tools.name: iDRAC Connection Manager
tools.description: PowerShell Windows Forms interface for managing Dell server iDRAC access.
tools.whatItDoes: GUI utility for organizing Dell servers and simplifying iDRAC GUI and console access. Provides centralized management of multiple iDRAC connections.
tools.valueProposition: Simplifies management of multiple Dell servers, reduces time spent accessing individual iDRAC interfaces, and provides organized server inventory and quick access.

tools.name: KeyRelay
tools.description: GUI utility for sending text to applications that block clipboard paste operations.
tools.whatItDoes: Sends text to applications that do not allow normal clipboard paste operations. Useful for RDP sessions, secure terminals, and applications with paste restrictions.
tools.valueProposition: Overcomes paste restrictions in secure environments, reduces manual typing errors, and improves productivity when working with applications that block clipboard access.

tools.name: LogCollector
tools.description: Comprehensive log collection tool for Windows, Dell servers, and supported switches.
tools.whatItDoes: Collects troubleshooting logs from Windows, Dell servers, and supported switches. Prepares diagnostic data for investigation or support cases.
tools.valueProposition: Automates log collection process, ensures comprehensive diagnostic data gathering, and reduces time spent preparing data for support cases.

tools.name: GetShowTech
tools.description: Dell switch show-tech diagnostic output collection tool.
tools.whatItDoes: Collects Dell switch show-tech diagnostic output for troubleshooting and support case preparation.
tools.valueProposition: Simplifies switch diagnostic data collection, ensures comprehensive switch information gathering, and reduces time spent preparing switch data for support.

tools.name: SDDC Dell Enhanced
tools.description: SDDC diagnostic data collection workflow for Azure Stack HCI environments.
tools.whatItDoes: Runs the SDDC diagnostic data-collection workflow for Azure Stack HCI environments. Collects comprehensive diagnostic information for troubleshooting.
tools.valueProposition: Automates SDDC diagnostic data collection, ensures comprehensive information gathering for Azure Stack HCI issues, and reduces troubleshooting time.

tools.name: SDDC Offline Dell Enhanced
tools.description: Offline SDDC diagnostic data collection for environments without internet access.
tools.whatItDoes: Collects SDDC diagnostic information when the target environment does not have direct internet access. Uses offline workflow for air-gapped environments.
tools.valueProposition: Enables SDDC diagnostics in air-gapped environments, provides same comprehensive data collection as online version, and supports restricted network scenarios.

tools.name: TSR Collector
tools.description: Dell Technical Support Report collector for cluster nodes via iDRAC.
tools.whatItDoes: Collects a Dell Technical Support Report (TSRs) from all nodes in a cluster via the iDRAC. Automates TSR collection across multiple cluster nodes.
tools.valueProposition: Automates TSR collection across cluster nodes, reduces manual intervention, and ensures comprehensive diagnostic data gathering for support cases.

tools.name: TALI
tools.description: Test-DellAzureLocalIssues - Azure Local cluster health and configuration checker.
tools.whatItDoes: Checks Dell Azure Local clusters for a broad set of common configuration, health, storage, networking, service, control-plane, and AKS Arc issues. Comprehensive health validation.
tools.valueProposition: Proactively identifies Azure Local configuration and health issues before they cause failures, provides comprehensive cluster health assessment, and reduces deployment and operational issues.

tools.name: FLCkr
tools.description: File-system filter driver altitude checker for Windows troubleshooting.
tools.whatItDoes: Checks file-system filter driver altitudes to identify potential conflicts or issues with filter driver stack configuration.
tools.valueProposition: Identifies filter driver conflicts that can cause system instability, helps troubleshoot storage and file system issues, and provides visibility into driver stack configuration.

tools.name: Convert-Etl2Pcap
tools.description: Windows ETL network trace to PCAP format converter.
tools.whatItDoes: Converts Windows ETL network traces to PCAP format for analysis with standard network analysis tools like Wireshark.
tools.valueProposition: Enables analysis of Windows network traces with standard tools, improves network troubleshooting capabilities, and bridges Windows ETL format with industry-standard PCAP.

tools.name: CluChk
tools.description: Automated validator for Storage Spaces Direct and Azure Local clusters that checks configurations against industry best practices.
tools.whatItDoes: Scans S2D and Azure Local cluster configurations against Microsoft and Dell best practices, extracts actionable errors and warnings from cluster logs, evaluates storage, networking, and hardware health, and provides guided troubleshooting context for support engineers.
tools.valueProposition: Significantly reduces mean time to resolution for Dell and Microsoft support teams by automating manual log analysis and configuration checks. It identifies misconfigurations, storage-health risks, and system bottlenecks before they escalate, helping prevent downtime and diagnostic errors.

tools.name: DriFT
tools.description: Comprehensive monitoring solution for platform health metrics and alerting.
tools.whatItDoes: Monitors platform health across multiple dimensions including performance, availability, security, and compliance. Provides real-time dashboards, automated alerting, and incident response integration.
tools.valueProposition: Improves platform reliability through proactive monitoring, reduces mean time to resolution (MTTR) with automated alerting, and ensures compliance with security and operational standards.

tools.name: SLIC
tools.description: SLIC automatically parses switch logs and provides an HTML output for Dell Switches
tools.whatItDoes: SLIC automatically parses switch logs and provides an HTML output for Dell Switches
tools.valueProposition: SLIC automatically parses switch logs and provides an HTML output for Dell Switches
